purpose: payment provider, invalid credentials instead of timeouts
text: Since the deploy at 09:40 UTC every card payment through Stripe fails immediately. payment-service logs show 401 Unauthorized from the provider with 'invalid API key'. PayGate payments go through fine.

Several customers were charged twice for the monthly invoice. billing-service logs show the invoicing job was retried after a deadlock on the billing PostgreSQL instance and the retry is not idempotent. Payments themselves look normal.

purpose: api-gateway as root cause, all downstream services healthy
text: All external clients get 502 Bad Gateway since 03:15 UTC. Internal health checks of auth-service, payment-service and billing-service are green. api-gateway logs are full of 'upstream SSL certificate verify failed'; the internal certificate was rotated last night.

A few users in Brazil say they do not get SMS one-time codes for confirming withdrawals; e-mail codes work and they can switch to e-mail. notification-service logs show intermittent 503 from the SMS provider for +55 numbers only.

purpose: reporting-service failing itself, no DB impact on payments
text: Finance cannot export the monthly settlement CSV: reporting-service returns 500 after about 60 seconds. Payment latency and DB CPU are normal. reporting-service logs show 'query canceled due to statement timeout'.

Login takes 8-10 seconds for everyone, and some mobile sessions time out on token refresh. auth-service p99 latency jumped from 120ms to 9s at 14:20 UTC; CPU on auth-service pods is at 100%. No errors in other services.

purpose: non-English input (German) - answer must be English
